compat.notes: EXPERIMENTAL: ONNX Runtime CPU (Microsoft 1.31.0, 8 threads). Oracle texts 8/8 (greedy and beam+LM) through the Rust backend on 8 synthetic TTS clips; logits rel-L2 <= 1.7e-6 against the PyTorch fp32 oracle. Windows 11, Ryzen 7 9700X: 29.5 s window 820 ms model part (RTF 0.028), 8 s window 237 ms. Apple M4 Max CPU: 29.5 s in 293 ms. DirectML (wheel 1.24) and CUDA (wheel 1.31.0) also reproduce the texts; CUDA 83 ms but needs CUDA runtime libraries, DirectML is slower than CPU at 29.5 s. Dynamic frame count, single 29.5 s window, batch 1; install by offline import. Not promoted to VALIDATED (no real-speech accuracy set).

provenance.notes: audio_tower of the Google base (text/vision towers dropped) with the 96 LoRA pairs (r16, alpha32) merged in fp32 as W + 2.0*B@A, then Reader; exported by the legacy TorchScript ONNX exporter (torch 2.9.1, opset 17) with a dynamic frame axis: local attention without unfold, in-graph blocked mask, attention matmuls kept 4-D, RMSNorm on x/16, ReLU as clamp, no packing in the Reader. Modified weights: not the upstream release.
